what_it_does: Automated mobile UI testing uses programs (testing tools) that crawl through an app's screens, tapping buttons and filling forms to look for bugs. Running multiple testing devices in parallel should speed this up, but in practice each device's testing tool wanders into overlapping parts of the app, doing redundant work. TaOPT solves this by analyzing the app under test to identify loosely connected regions of the app's screen-state graph — groups of screens that can be explored independently without needing to pass through each other. It then assigns different devices to different regions, so the devices collectively cover more unique ground. Crucially, TaOPT does not require modifying the testing tool itself — it works as an outer coordination layer, steering whichever tool is already in use. As testing progresses, it updates its region assignments dynamically based on what each device has already covered.
